title: CI red: web flow tests need the wasm built; sources conformance expects 6 sources, catalog has 9
description: CI run 36266751246 on main (1902ecd). Web job: test/beat, chords, melody fail with ENOENT target/wasm32-wasip1/release/apricity_web.wasm — the job never builds the wasm.
